base_note: stacked on agent/p-p21-line-anchor-range, which is stacked on agent/s-p20-nosecret-noop; all three touch papers/phase1-workshop/verify_paper.py or its run records.
summary: P21 found three out-of-range line anchors in the papers run records, two of them RES-2's own in S34's record. This item appends the correction and files the fleet-wide pattern as a proposal rather than acting on it.

findings.what: papers/runs/20260729T224939Z-S34/RUN_STATE.md cites monitor/ci/merge.log seven times by line number. All seven are correct -- merge.log is append-only and the committed blob is a byte-exact prefix of the working tree's, checked -- and FIVE of the seven are past the end of merge.log in the commit S34 shipped (1862 lines). Read from the repo root's working tree, committed beside a checkout that was further behind.
findings.resolution: a correction appended to the record (not an edit -- the record is provenance and the error is the finding), replacing every line anchor with the UTC timestamp in column 1, which append-only guarantees and a line number does not. No substantive claim changes: the claims are carried by the entries, and every entry is where the document said it was.

findings.what: P21's range check saw two of the five, because the other three are written as a bare `:1894` with no filename inside the backticks. That citation form is read by NO check in this repository: check B needs a '/', check F needs a basename with an artefact suffix, and the anchor check hangs off both.
findings.resolution: recorded, not gated. Whether a bare `:NNNN` is a defect depends on each territory's citation convention, and this is one territory.

findings.what: the fleet-wide version: every territory writes runs/, and any of them can cite a growing log
findings.resolution: filed as monitor/inbox/20260730T0315Z-RES-2-a-line-anchor-into-a-growing-log-is-wrong-when-committed.md. Three proposals, only the first recommended: write 'cite append-only logs by timestamp, not by line' into the provenance convention. Building a gate is explicitly NOT recommended -- P19 already paid that tuition, and gating the run records today is 109 findings on arrival.

verification.gate: papers: green -- verify_paper: PASS (6/6), 184 passed, unchanged by this item
verification.note: this item ships prose and a proposal, not code. The gate is run to show the appended correction does not break check B, E or F -- an appended table of paths and timestamps is exactly the kind of text those checks read.
